scientific_integrity: Computationally certified finite theorem for the canonical 24-vertex Nauru graph; exact algorithms and explicit complementary primal/dual-style finite witnesses; no invented authorship or independent review.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to GP(12,5), not to all generalized Petersen graphs.
Literature priority may be affected by unindexed equivalent results; the 2025 survey was only inspected at abstract/bibliography level.
The historical 2007 Nauru-graph date is corroborated by the original author’s dated retrospective, because the original weblog address was unavailable.
title: Nauru-graph anti-forcing spectrum and the hidden split of two-factor profiles
